newsitem.title: USA: Protection One to buy Portland company.
newsitem.headline: Protection One to buy Portland company.

text.p: Protection One Inc said on Wednesday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire substantially all of the assets of Phillips Electronics Inc, a private alarm company in Portland, Oregon.
Protection One will pay a total of about $14.5 million for the company. It will issue about $2.0 million worth of its common stock to Phillips to help fund the deal.
Founded in 1952, Phillips Electronics currently has about 12,000 subscribers. Most all are located in the Portland area, and about 70 percent live in residential neighborhoods.
The deal will boost Protection One's share of Portland's residential market to over 25 percent, it believes.
In a statement, the company said the acquisition is central to Protection One's strategy of building significant subscriber density in core markets.
